integrity: The stabilizer upper bounds are proved from component degrees, the unique concurrence point, and coefficient comparison; the finite verifier is used only to replay the explicit group action and subgroup counts.
scientific_limitations: The result is over C and concerns embedded projective stabilizers of the two displayed arrangements. It does not classify complement automorphisms or arbitrary flex-line subconfigurations.
title: Exact projective symmetry drop in two free Fermat cubic-line arrangements
